statement: For the centered symmetric family with masses (1-1/n)/2 at +/-n^(1/3) and 1/(2n) at +/-n^(2/3), the lower variance exponent is 1/3 while the uniform upper exponential-moment exponent is 2/3.
assumptions: Integer n>=2; exponent definitions are the analogous all-n moment thresholds, not FPP exponents.
proof_or_counterexample: INDEPENDENT.md: Var X_n=(1-1/n)n^(2/3)+n^(1/3). For a<2/3, E exp(alpha|X_n|/n^a)>=exp(alpha n^(2/3-a))/n diverges for every alpha>0; for a>=2/3 it is <=exp(alpha).
remaining_gap: No iid lattice-FPP realization is supplied; only the variance-to-exponential-tail inference is refuted.

statement: On a four-edge square graph with iid Uniform[1,2] weights and opposite-corner endpoints, let A,B be its two route costs. Conditional on A<B, P(A<=3)=P(B>=3)=3/4 and P(A<=3,B>=3)=1/2; the conditional product 9/16 is false.
assumptions: Finite square graph only; disjoint two-edge routes; iid continuous Uniform[1,2]; condition on the top route being the unique geodesic.
proof_or_counterexample: ATTEMPT.md, Obstruction B: each cost has median 3, exchangeability splits each same-median quadrant in half, and the cross quadrant has probability 1/4 and is contained in A<B. Divide by P(A<B)=1/2. verification.json also checks an atomic 16-state analogue.
remaining_gap: Does not refute unconditional independence in deterministic disjoint domains or establish a full-lattice counterexample.

statement: For nearest-neighbor FPP on Z^d, d>=2, with every edge weight in [1,2], D(0,e1)=0 for every environment, so a strictly positive lower bound inf_{v!=0} ED(0,v)/|v|^b>0 is impossible for any real b.
assumptions: Undirected nearest-neighbor lattice; positive bounded weights in [1,2]; D is maximum distance of a minimizing path from the endpoint segment.
proof_or_counterexample: ATTEMPT.md, Obstruction C: the direct edge costs <=2, every other simple path has at least three edges and costs >=3, and loops have positive cost. The direct edge is therefore the unique minimizing path.
remaining_gap: A sufficiently-large-distance lower bound, as in Chatterjee (A4), is untouched; do not reject the KPZ target.

statement: High-probability agreement of costs in [n,2n] does not imply variance transfer: T_n=n and Y_n=n+nB_n with B_n Bernoulli(1/n) agree with probability 1-1/n but have Var T_n=0, Var Y_n=n-1, and E(Y_n-T_n)^2=n.
assumptions: Integer n>=2; abstract cost coupling, not a constructed FPP environment.
proof_or_counterexample: ATTEMPT.md, Obstruction D; verification.json enumerates the exact two-state coupling. The rare discrepancy has magnitude n and probability 1/n.
remaining_gap: The actual cylinder route must control its L2 discrepancy relative to the passage-time standard deviation, not just the failure probability.

statement: The norm g(x)=max(||x||_1,(3/2)||x||_infinity) has square-lattice symmetries and ||x||_1<=g(x)<=(3/2)||x||_1, yet for even n and w+1<=n/4, z=(n/2,w+1) gives g(z)+g(ne1-z)-g(ne1)=0 outside the width-w cylinder.
assumptions: A norm countermodel on R^2; n even and w>=1 integer; no realization as an iid FPP time constant is claimed.
proof_or_counterexample: GEOMETRY_OBSTRUCTION.md proves the norm axioms and evaluates g(ne1)=3n/2, g(z)=g(ne1-z)=3n/4. It fails every positive c w^2/n bend despite meeting the elementary candidate-law bounds.
remaining_gap: Independent check pending. FPP-specific curvature and nonrandom-error control remain missing inputs; this countermodel is not an FPP law.

statement: The frozen w372 packet's unconditional cylinder variance-transfer bound 2(s-2delta)_+^2<=Var(F1-F2)<=2(s+2delta)^2 and conditional mean-gap localization bound survive this adversarial audit under their stated premises.
assumptions: F_i have the same square-integrable distribution with sd s; G_i iid square-integrable; Delta_i=G_i-F_i>=0 have equal mean and L2 norm <=delta.
Localization additionally requires a>=0 and fixed alpha,M with uniform exponential centered moments, plus a positive deterministic mean gap H_n at all possible departing vertices.
proof_or_counterexample: PAIRED_AUDIT.md rederives the central L2 inequality and the deterministic-vertex Markov/union bound. Snapshot hash identifies only the bytes; it is not proof. No input independence is inferred after selection.
remaining_gap: w374 independently kept the same L2/L4 reductions. Actual Uniform[1,2] mean gap and global exponent matching remain unproved.

statement: For iid Uniform[1,2] FPP on Z^2, existence of simultaneous uniform matching upper exponential-moment and lower variance/mean exponents supplies a sufficient reduction to chi=2xi-1 through Chatterjee Theorem 1.1; the reduction does not prove existence of those inputs.
assumptions: All four epsilon-slack bounds in ATTEMPT.md hold with constants independent of endpoints; lower estimates use a sufficiently-large-distance cutoff.
Continuous nearly-gamma law and finite moment generating function as in the published theorem.
proof_or_counterexample: ATTEMPT.md specifies all quantifiers, squeezes chi_a=chi_b and xi_a=xi_b, and applies the published conditional theorem. Its additional relative-tail route is conditional on a tail estimate at the actual variance scale.
remaining_gap: The four matching estimates and the relative-tail input are not proved for this law; current openness and novelty remain UNKNOWN/no claim.
